name: SunTop Food Safe
summary: Amazon brand marketing PLA+ and PETG made with food-contact compliant raw materials, plus PLA+ silk and matte, ABS+, ABS-CF, ABS-GF, ASA, PETG-CF and PC, mostly 1 kg at about $12-23/kg and a 4 kg PLA+ bundle at $10/kg. The seller is Andersun Global Inc. in Taoyuan, Taiwan; the extruder is unknown.

product_lines.name: PLA+ (incl. 'Food Safe High Speed PRO')
product_lines.notes: 1 kg $11.72-20.99; 4 x 1 kg bundle $10/kg. Titles say 'made with food-contact compliant raw materials'.

product_lines.name: PETG (standard, high speed, matte, food safe)

additional_notes: Legal entity: Andersun Global Inc. (verbatim; no rendering needed), Taoyuan District, Taoyuan City, Taiwan (No. 10-1, Emei 3rd St.); Amazon seller 'Andersun 3d filament' (id A1F7YOOBPA23HI), read 2026-11-06. The listing's Manufacturer field reads 'SunTop Food Safe'. Store is Amazon only; no brand website was identified. Andersun Global Inc. reads as a trading company, so the extruder is unknown. The food-safety wording is a listing claim about raw materials, not a certification that was checked. First-pass note kept: despite the name, no link to Sunlu was found.
